parameters.query:
INSERT INTO articles (title, url, source, published_at, category, summary, content)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::timestamptz, $5, $6, $7)
ON CONFLICT (url) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, title;

INSERT INTO article_topics (article_id, topic_id)
VALUES ($1, $2)
ON CONFLICT (article_id, topic_id) DO NOTHING

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.url, a.source, a.published_at, a.category, a.summary
FROM articles a
WHERE a.published_at >= $2::timestamptz
AND ($1 = '' OR a.id IN (SELECT at.article_id FROM article_topics at INNER JOIN topics t ON t.id = at.topic_id WHERE t.slug = $1))
ORDER BY a.published_at DESC

meta.notes:
## Full Pipeline (Webhook)

Combines RSS ingestion + digest generation into a single webhook-triggered workflow.
Triggered via POST /webhook/pipeline from the app's Refresh Data button.

Expects body: { topicSlug?, topicId?, range?, rangeStart?, feeds: string[] }
- When topicId is set, newly inserted articles are linked in article_topics (article_id, topic_id).
- Digest is built from articles in range, filtered by topicSlug when set.
Returns: { ingested, indexed, digest: { articleCount, markdown } }
